name: stanvx-flow
description: A proof-gated idea-to-ship stack for Claude Code. Install flow and it brings Matt Pocock's skills and the plugins its stages lean on.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's agent skills for real engineering (grilling, spec/ticket flows, TDD, code review, domain modelling and more).

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: The mod that walks a task through the flow and holds a build until its checks prove it. Installing it installs the rest of the stack: mattpocock-skills, ponytail and typesafe.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: The lazy senior developer: the least code that works. Runs under every stage.

plugins.name: typesafe
plugins.description: The typesafe-ai skill: how to build with Jev, for anyone changing the flow mod's Jev questions.
